placement.text: Saturn is in the 2nd house (Dhana bhav) in Virgo. This house covers wealth, savings, family, speech, food, early education. It is a maraka house (2/7) – houses that can bring health strain in difficult periods. Saturn is in a friend's sign – supported, gives fair results. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 6 & 7 (enemies; marriage), so those matters are carried into the 2nd house. It is a functional malefic for this ascendant (rules 3/6/8/11). Conjunct (yuti) with Jupiter. Aspected by Ketu. It aspects houses 4, 8, 11. Nakshatra Hasta (pada 2, ruled by Moon).

temples.name: Darbaranyeswarar (Saneeswaran) Temple, Thirunallar
temples.what: The most important Saturn temple. King Nala was freed from Saturn's affliction here; devotees apply sesame oil and bathe in Nala Theertham before darshan. Very crowded on Saturdays and at Shani Peyarchi (Saturn's sign change; the latest was 6 March 2026, Aquarius → Pisces).

temples.name: Shani Shingnapur
temples.deity: Shani as a self-manifested black stone, open to the sky
temples.what: Devotees do tail-abhishek (oil poured over the stone) to ease Sade Sati and Dhaiya. Shani Amavasya (new moon on a Saturday) is the biggest day. Since 2025 the trust accepts only branded oil.

temples.name: Navagraha Mandir, Chitrachal Hill
temples.what: Built in 1752 by Ahom king Rajeshwar Singha. Nine Shiva-lingas, one per graha, each draped in its colour, with the Sun at the centre – worship of all nine together.

interpretation.name: Kaal Sarp Dosha
interpretation.text: All seven classical planets are hemmed on one side of the Rahu-Ketu nodal axis. A popular modern astrological concept linked to non-linear progress and sudden turning points; should be judged in the context of the whole chart.

interpretation.name: Ascendant Lord in 5th House
interpretation.text: Sun, the ascendant lord, is in the 5th house: sharp intellect, creative inclinations and wise discernment; blessed with merits from past deeds and good progeny.

interpretation.name: Sunapha Yoga
interpretation.text: Planets other than the Sun occupy the 2nd house from the Moon. Indicates wealth acquired through one's own efforts, good intelligence, and a respectable status.

interpretation.name: Budhaditya Yoga
interpretation.text: Sun and Mercury are conjunct in the same sign. Confers intellectual agility, communicative ability, and scholarly interests. Very common as Mercury stays close to the Sun.

interpretation.name: Yogakaraka Planet
interpretation.text: A single planet rules both an angle (kendra) and a trine (trikona) for this ascendant, making it the most auspicious functional benefic in the chart. Its periods are generally productive.

interpretation.name: Raja Yoga (Kendra-Trikona Lords)
interpretation.text: The lord of an angle and the lord of a trine form an association through conjunction, mutual aspect, or sign exchange. Enhances status, authority, and prosperity, particularly in their dashas.

interpretation.name: Dhana Yoga
interpretation.text: Wealth lords (2nd or 11th) connect with dharma/lakshmi lords (1st, 5th, or 9th). Promotes accumulation of assets and financial prosperity, especially during their operating dashas.

interpretation.name: Parivartana Yoga (Mutual Reception)
interpretation.text: Two planets occupy each other's signs, intertwining the indications of their respective houses. The outcome depends on whether auspicious or challenging houses are involved.
